title: Kestrel and the Letters
author: Edmund Crane
blurb: Xanthe Quintana, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
